description: Match an error message or symptom from an app built with an AI app builder or deployed to a common host (Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Replit, Base44, Supabase, Firebase, Stripe, Vercel, Netlify, Next.js, Clerk, Prisma, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini APIs) to the closest plain-English fix guide on vibecodefixes.com. Returns what the error means, likely causes and first steps, quoted from that guide, with a link to the full free guide. If nothing matches confidently it says so instead of guessing. Read-only: it does not connect to, read or change the user's app, accounts or code, and it collects no personal data.

platform.description: Optional. Where the app was built or runs, e.g. 'Lovable', 'Bolt', 'v0', 'Cursor', 'Replit', 'Supabase', 'Vercel', 'Netlify'.

problem.description: The exact error text or a plain description of what is going wrong, e.g. 'new row violates row-level security policy for table todos' or 'my Lovable custom domain is stuck on verifying'.

name: diagnose_app_problem
title: Diagnose a vibe-coded app problem
